result.note: Tests the maiden flight-test of DRDO's Kusha long-range surface-to-air missile: the missile type and the test site.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the Kusha missile, which had its maiden flight-test in July 2026:
items: It is a long-range surface-to-air missile developed by the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO).
Its maiden flight-test was conducted from APJ Abdul Kalam Island off the coast of Odisha.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: DRDO flight-tested the Kusha long-range surface-to-air missile from APJ Abdul Kalam Island off Odisha on 23 July 2026, intercepting an electronic target that simulated a high-speed, high-altitude threat. DRDO says the system can engage fighter jets, missiles, drones and large aircraft, and its missiles, radars and command centre were developed by DRDO laboratories and industry partners.
questions.source: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) conducted the maiden flight-test of the Kusha long-range surface-to-air missile from APJ Abdul Kalam Island off Odisha on July 23, 2026, intercepting an electronic target simulating a high-speed, high-altitude aerial threat.
